Introducing the OrthoBrush Manual Toothbrush by SuperMouth, an innovative orthodontic toothbrush created specifically for brace wearers. Using the same advanced technology found in our adult and kids’ toothbrushes, we scanned the teeth of thousands of orthodontic patients to develop a toothbrush for braces that delivers a deeper, gentler clean.

This braces care toothbrush is engineered with patent-pending bristles that glide comfortably around brackets and wires while helping remove plaque without damaging gums or orthodontic appliances. Unlike a standard manual toothbrush for braces, the OrthoBrush is carefully crafted to improve oral care for braces and reduce the risk of cavities, white spots, and decalcifications that can develop during orthodontic treatment.

Whether you are looking for the best toothbrush for braces or a more effective way to maintain orthodontic oral hygiene, our orthodontic toothbrush offers a smarter solution for everyday tooth cleaning for braces.

  • World’s first orthodontic-specific manual toothbrush
  • Gentle bristles provide comfortable brushing with braces while protecting gums
  • Cleans up to 23 times better than a standard manual toothbrush
  • Patent-pending bristles designed for cleaning braces with toothbrush precision
  • Effectively cleans around brackets, wires, and orthodontic appliances
  • Developed by scanning thousands of orthodontic teeth for a tailored fit
  • Helps reduce plaque buildup, cavities, and decalcification during orthodontic treatment
  • Ideal toothbrush for braces care, orthodontic maintenance, and daily oral hygiene

FAQs
items.html:
What makes the OrthoBrush different from a regular toothbrush?
The OrthoBrush is an orthodontic toothbrush specifically designed for braces care. Its patent-pending bristles help clean around brackets and wires more effectively than a standard manual toothbrush, improving oral care for braces and reducing plaque buildup.
Is the OrthoBrush suitable for sensitive teeth and gums
Yes, our toothbrush for brace wearers features gentle yet effective bristles that provide comfortable brushing with braces. It is designed to clean thoroughly without irritating gums or damaging orthodontic appliances.
Why is using a specialized toothbrush for braces important?
A braces toothbrush helps clean hard-to-reach areas around brackets and wires where plaque can build up quickly. Proper brushing with braces can help reduce the risk of cavities, white spots, and decalcification during orthodontic treatment.
Can the OrthoBrush help improve orthodontic oral hygiene?
Yes, the OrthoBrush is designed to support better orthodontic oral hygiene by improving tooth cleaning for braces. Its advanced bristle design helps remove food particles and plaque while maintaining healthier teeth and gums.
Who should use the OrthoBrush Manual Toothbrush?
The OrthoBrush is ideal for kids, teens, and adults with braces who want a more effective toothbrush for orthodontic care. It is a great option for anyone looking for a braces-friendly toothbrush that delivers a deep and gentle clean every day.
